WITH customer_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(Total) as customer_total
  FROM Invoice
  GROUP BY CustomerId
),
overall_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(Total) as total_revenue
  FROM Invoice
),
customer_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_total,
    customer_total / (SELECT total_revenue FROM overall_total) as share
  FROM customer_totals
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM customer_shares
),
filtered_customers AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_total,
    share
  FROM customer_shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share)
)
SELECT 
  AVG(customer_total),
  AVG(share),
  AVG(share) - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share)
FROM filtered_customers
